title: Inpainting physics: self-supervised learning for context-driven fluid simulation
abstract: arXiv:2605.08832v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural surrogate models for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are typically trained as forward operators that map explicit problem specifications, such as geometry and boundary conditions, to solution fields. This ties the model to the conditioning variables seen during training and limits reuse under boundary-condition shifts or local geometry changes. We propose to reformulate steady CFD inference as an inpainting problem: instead of training on explicit boundary conditions, we learn a self-supervised prior over velocity fields and impose boundary constraints only during inference by fixing known regions such as inlet, outlet or unchanged regions from previous simulations. To scale this idea to large 3D meshes, we introduce a local neighbourhood tokeniser that represents high-resolution velocity fields as compact spatial latent tokens and train latent flow-matching and masked-autoencoder models on these tokens. translated_title: 物理修复：基于自监督学习的上下文驱动流体模拟
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.08832v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：用于计算流体动力学（CFD）的神经替代模型通常被训练为正向算子，将显式问题规格（如几何形状和边界条件）映射到解场。这使模型与训练期间所见到的条件变量紧密耦合，并在边界条件变化或局部几何修改时限制了其复用性。我们提出将稳态CFD推理重新表述为修复问题：不依赖显式边界条件进行训练，而是学习速度场的自监督先验，仅在推理期间通过固定已知区域（如入口、出口或先前模拟中未变化的区域）来施加边界约束。为了将此方法扩展到大型三维网格，我们引入了一种局部邻域分词器，将高分辨率速度场表示为紧凑的空间潜在令牌，并在此类令牌上训练潜在流匹配和掩码自编码器模型。在颅内动脉瘤案例中...
tldr: 本文提出将稳态CFD推理重新定义为修复问题，通过自监督学习速度场先验并在推理时施加边界约束，结合局部邻域分词器实现大规模三维网格的高效流体模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates steady CFD inference as an inpainting problem, learning a self-supervised prior over velocity fields and imposing boundary constraints only during inference, with a local neighborhood tokenizer enabling scalable 3D mesh simulation.
